drug_class: Intravenous Nutritional Supplement / Parenteral Nutrition Solution
purpose: This medicine is a special liquid given directly into your vein to provide your body with protein building blocks called amino acids. It is used when you cannot eat normally or when your body needs extra nutrition, such as after surgery, during serious illness, or when your digestive system is not working properly. It helps your body heal, maintain muscle, and keep your organs functioning well.
how_it_works: Think of amino acids as the tiny Lego pieces your body uses to build and repair proteins — which are essential for muscles, healing wounds, fighting infection, and keeping organs working. Because this solution goes straight into your bloodstream through an IV, it bypasses your stomach and intestines entirely. Your body then uses these amino acids just like it would from food, helping you stay strong and recover faster.
common_side_effects: Nausea or vomiting, mild fever, flushing or warmth at the IV site, headache, and increased urination. You may also notice changes in your blood sugar levels, so your nurses will monitor this closely.
warnings: This solution must always be given by a healthcare professional in a clinical setting — never at home without proper supervision. It can cause serious problems if given too fast, including fluid overload, electrolyte imbalances, or liver stress. People with kidney disease, liver disease, or certain metabolic conditions need special monitoring or dose adjustments. Rarely, it can cause serious infections if the IV line is not kept sterile. Always tell your doctor about all your medical conditions and medications before receiving this treatment.
typical_dosing: The dose is carefully calculated by your doctor or pharmacist based on your body weight, medical condition, and nutritional needs. It is usually given as a slow, continuous drip through an IV over many hours each day. A common starting range is about 1 to 2 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight per day, but your healthcare team will determine exactly the right amount for you and adjust it as your condition changes.
